title: Revert to Version 5

requirements.text: Remove the FocusGuard logo from the Header component that was added in Version 6
acceptanceCriteria: The logo image or logo component is removed from the Header component
The header displays only navigation buttons and theme toggle as in Version 5

requirements.text: Revert Dashboard component styling to Version 5 appearance by removing the enhanced visual depth, soft shades, and refined card shadows that were added in Version 6
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard uses the simpler card-based layout from Version 5 without the enhanced depth effects
Background contrasts and shadow refinements from Version 6 are removed

requirements.text: Restore light mode theming to Version 5 color palette by reverting the soft gray/tinted backgrounds and gentle shadows added in Version 6
acceptanceCriteria: Light mode uses the Version 5 color scheme
Soft gray backgrounds and refined shadows from Version 6 are removed
All components display with Version 5 light mode styling

requirements.text: Restore dark mode theming to Version 5 appearance by reverting the deep dark backgrounds and refined card contrast introduced in Version 6
acceptanceCriteria: Dark mode uses the Version 5 color scheme
Enhanced background depth and card contrast from Version 6 are removed
All components display with Version 5 dark mode styling

constraints: Maintain all existing functionality while reverting only visual styling changes
Do not modify backend main.mo or migration.mo files
Preserve immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity.ts, useInternetIdentity.tsx, useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui
nonGoals: Modifying timer, camera monitoring, or music player functionality
Changing backend data structures or session tracking logic
